instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: He didn’t have the ((heart)) to tell her.
atoms.finishSound: He didn’t have the heart to tell her.

atoms.b: The cat might ((appear)) to be scared.
atoms.finishSound: The cat might appear to be scared.

atoms.b: I will soon ((arrive)) at my destination.
atoms.finishSound: I will soon arrive at my destination.

atoms.b: She needs a ((breath)) of fresh air.
atoms.finishSound: She needs a breath of fresh air.

atoms.b: You can draw the sun with a yellow ((circle)).
atoms.finishSound: You can draw the sun with a yellow circle.
